title: Chapter 1372
text:
Under the deliberate publicity of the three Universal Civilizations, within a few days, the news of Black Star using the Sanctum Revival to awaken many historical Beyond Grade As spread like wildfire. It spread throughout the troops stationed in the interception circle, instantly boosting their morale.

Beyond Grade As were not only high-level combatants, but they were also the representatives of individual experts. During the war, they were also one of the spiritual pillars of many soldiers. The more individuals there were in the army, the more confident the soldiers would be.

The relevant information was also specially sent back to the galactic society, which also caused a large number of people and various organizations to be excited.

In the past, a large number of galactic residents hated the Sanctum Revival, thinking that it was the confidence of the Beyond Grade A privileged class. However, now that most of the Beyond Grade As had gone to resist foreign enemies and become the force to protect the galactic society, the attitude of these galactic residents changed. They were not stingy with their praise for the Sanctum Revival and wished that more historical Beyond Grade As would revive to protect their safety.

Even during wartime, the distribution company of Wayne Cards did not miss the business opportunity and launched a new "Revivors" series of card packs. If there were some Character Summon Cards and Force Cards that had a special relationship with each other on the field at the same time, it could even trigger the interaction function and have different reactions as a hidden easter egg.

The reactions of the various organizations were not as one-sided as the excitement of the public. They secretly evaluated the impact of this matter on themselves, especially the organizations that had ties with these historical Beyond Grade As.

In a certain branch of the Machinery Faith.

In the spacious hall of the temple, bishops wearing the Mechanical Priest robes of different factions gathered one after another and discussed in low voices. Their voices were filled with uncontrollable excitement.

"The original God has returned. We should worship his honorific name again!"

"I never thought that one day, I would be able to see the living Nilfgadi."

The bishops were excited.

As the original Mechanical Deity, Nilfgadi had a special status in the Machinery Faith.

Because only by worshipping a living Mechanical Deity could the believers receive feedback, the dead Mechanical Deities only had a commemorative meaning left and became the 'old gods' that were rarely mentioned.

However, Nilfgadi was an exception. Every time they prayed, the believers of the Machinery Faith would chant his honorific name. This was a treatment that the other Mechanical Deities did not have.

Now that Nilfgadi had come back to life, they could restore the worship.

However, the Machinery Faith was a group of extremely realistic believers. Although Nilfgaardi's position was special, it would not immediately shake Black Star's current position, unless he could prove that his machinery was stronger.

Furthermore, the Sanctum Revival was a product brought about by Black Star. All the archbishops present considered this point and reached a consensus.

"Although the meaning of the Original God is different, he was brought back by Black Star. Nilfgaardi's current position should not be above Black Star."

"That's right. It was Black Star who awakened the old gods one by one and revived the glory of the sect. In view of this, we should give Black Star a new honorific name to distinguish him from the other Mechanical Deities and give him a unique status."

"Since Nilfgaardi is the original God, why don't we call Black Star the God of Revival?"

"It doesn't feel good. In my opinion, whether the old gods awaken or not is completely controlled by Black Star. Why don't we call him the Great Old Ones?"

"Why does it feel a little weird … Let's change it. I think the title 'Undying Black, Holy Venerable of the Church, Guardian of the Door of the Old Gods, Arbiter of Life and Death' is not bad."

"It's too long. This title of yours, those who don't know would think that it's four people."

"So what if it's long? Just say if it's nice or not!"

The group of archbishops argued fiercely over Black Star's new honorific name. Unable to convince each other, they even started to fight. They dismantled each other's oil pipes, and each other pulled out their piston pumps, hurting each other.

…

In the Central Galaxy, on a man-made habitable planet.

A transport fleet with the logo of the Black Star Corps slowly sailed into the spaceport. Under the guidance of the port's smart robots, huge cuboid-shaped transport ships docked at different docks.

The cabin doors opened one after another, and teams of Black Star Corps soldiers walked out. They formed a formation, stood in position, and took out their indicator lights to give orders. Then, a large number of Blue Star citizens walked out, forming long queues. They boarded the docks and headed to the arranged settlement.

The army soldiers maintained order. Although there was a slight commotion in the crowd, it was still orderly. However, the constant movement of looking left and right exposed the nervousness and curiosity in most people's hearts.

In the command room of the transport ship's bridge, Bennett looked down at the migrating crowd slowly moving on the docks with a complicated expression.

At the beginning of the war, he responded to Black Star's call and organized a long-distance migration of all Blue Star citizens. At that time, it naturally caused a lot of opposition. Many people were not willing to migrate, and there was a lot of resistance when it was carried out.

For most people, the mother planet was a feeling that was difficult to give up. No matter how far they wandered in the universe, the mother planet was the home of their soul. There were too many examples of people who were willing to live and die with their mother planet in the face of disaster.

However, these problems were all forcefully suppressed by Bennett. Regardless of whether they were willing or not, they were all packed up and sent to the transport fleet.

As the various Star Fields were undergoing a great migration, the efficiency of transportation was limited, and the transport fleet had been on the road for a long time. Along the way, Bennett had been emphasizing the necessity of doing so. He tried to reason with them and finally suppressed most of the dissatisfaction. Many people on Planet Aquamarine had no choice but to accept the reality. Instead, they began to worry and fear about the future.

Although this was only a temporary measure to take refuge, they were not sure if this would be the last time they saw their mother planet.

If the World Tree successfully invaded, the Flickering World would be the first to bear the brunt. The Shattered Star Ring was adjacent to the Flickering World, so it was very likely to become the second main battlefield. Perhaps one day, they would hear the news of their mother planet being destroyed from countless light years away.

"I wonder if I'll have the chance to go back after leaving my hometown this time …"

Bennett sighed softly with mixed feelings.

This time, a faint female voice sounded beside him.

"This is your new home. I'll escort you here."

"Thank you for your protection, Your Excellency Ames." Bennett turned around and thanked her.

"Hmm, I'll leave this place to you. I'll leave Floating Dragon Island behind as your guard."

Ames nodded casually and walked out of the cabin.

She was not at the frontlines at the moment. She originally had such thoughts, but Black Star had asked her to escort the Blue Star migration team, so she was delayed.

In fact, Ames knew that this was Black Star's request to protect her in disguise. However, the escort journey would eventually be over, and it was time for her to head to the frontlines.

Furthermore, she wanted to see with her own eyes what kind of existence the Nightmare that had forced Black Star to not stop for so many years was.

…

In the interception circle base group, the revivors were under house arrest.

In the vast starry sky, streams of light were constantly colliding, emitting shocking energy fluctuations. Shockingly, many Beyond Grade As were fighting with different revivors.

Han Xiao and his other companions who did not make a move stayed on the battleship to watch the battle. From time to time, they would use various means to offset the aftershocks.

The people who had just revived were not in their peak condition. During this period, they had been undergoing recovery training to get used to each other. As for the Mechanics and Mages who had been around for a long time, they still had to learn the new theories and technologies as much as possible in a short period of time, so they were very busy.

Because the Beyond Grade As guarding the interception circle had nothing to do, sparring with them became their current priority. They had been helping the revivors recover their combat strength and frequently exchanged pointers.

Although most of the revivors' knowledge base was behind the times, there were also some lost skills that were brought back by the revivors. They were not stingy with teaching, which indirectly increased the average strength of the current Beyond Grade As.

Among them, the one with the greatest increase in strength was Milizaus. He had finally gotten his wish to shrink his body size. He had only just learned the Dragon Language Secret Technique that the old ancestor had taught him, but he was already able to shrink his mothership-like body to about three hundred meters long. Just this alone made him overjoyed, and his combat strength had increased significantly.

According to him, as long as he mastered this secret technique, he would at most be able to shrink his dragon body to a length of more than ten meters. His density would increase explosively, like the difference between stone and steel.

"In the past, the old dragon had high HP, average defense, and basically zero evasion. He was just a target. Now that he has completed this transformation, not only will his defense increase explosively, his evasion rate will also return to normal. His agility will increase greatly, and his combat strength will increase by half a level."

Han Xiao guessed.

After watching the sparring for a while, he lowered his head and opened the interface. He glanced at the forums.

Thanks to the World Tree's beyond-visual-range tactic, the players had been carrying out suicide missions with extremely generous rewards. More than half of the IDs in the first tier on the Level Rankings had changed, and the players who were lucky enough to snatch the suicide missions had all gone up.

Meanwhile, the current number one player was six levels higher than the number one player two months ago. He had already reached Level 173, and he was only seven levels away from the current version's upper limit of Level 180. This leveling speed was considerably fast for players.

However, only a few people managed to snatch the suicide missions, and this kind of good thing would disappear very soon. Han Xiao had already provided the blueprint for the special observation device, and the three Universal Civilizations had been manufacturing it non-stop. They had already sent over a batch of shells and were waiting for him to complete the most important core process.

As long as they had the finished product of the detection device, the three Universal Civilizations would definitely use it in the battle very quickly and get rid of the World Tree's beyond-visual-range tactic in one go. This way, the players would only be able to participate in a large-scale Spacetime Splicing self-destruct operation at most, and they would not be able to enjoy this kind of high-quality compound fertilizer that stimulated growth in the future.

"I wonder what new plan the World Tree Civilization will come up with after breaking this tactic … Speaking of which, Destiny's Child doesn't seem to have gained much recently?"

Han Xiao stroked his chin thoughtfully.

According to Hella's report, the frequency of Destiny's Child taking effect had significantly decreased compared to the beginning. Furthermore, the information obtained from the surveillance was basically not too important, and it did not provide much help to the current situation.

This sign was a signal in Han Xiao's eyes. Either the World Tree Civilization felt that the effect of the foresight method was average and stopped using it on a large scale, or the World Tree Civilization realized the reason for the leak of information and consciously took precautions.

"Hmm … Did the World Tree notice something? It's faster than I expected."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

Although Destiny's Child's surveillance channel was hidden, through the analysis of the battle, he could always sense some of the actions of the three Universal Civilizations. It was as if he had received the news in advance, so he naturally suspected the possibility of the information being leaked.

Although it was very difficult to find out the mechanism of Destiny's Child, through the relevant data screening, the World Tree had a high chance of discovering that the foreseer was the source of the leak. The three Universal Civilizations could also do this, but their reaction speed would be slower.

Han Xiao was never sure that Destiny's Child would be able to hide it from the World Tree forever. After all, this was not something that could not be solved. He would not believe that this low-risk intelligence channel would always be reliable, but the longer it could be hidden, the better.

"If the World Tree realizes this, it might deliberately use this intelligence channel at some point in time and use the foreseer to send us misleading information … It seems like any information obtained from Destiny's Child in the future will have to be filtered first."

Han Xiaoxin pondered.

Just as he was thinking, the sparring in the field ended one after another. It was all about communication.

Kasuyi, who had watched the entire process, was filled with emotions.

"As expected of the heroes of history. There are as many experts as there are clouds."

"They're all people with great luck. The concentration of luck outside is almost over the limit. It's more balanced here." Secret Master nodded.

"I'm relieved to see them alive and kicking. These people are the monuments of our civilization's evolution history. They are the essence accumulated from generation to generation." Oulou, who was not far away, pretended to give pointers and acted like an old man.

"… But we're still stronger." Manison glanced at him indifferently.

Civilizations continued to develop, experience continued to be passed down, and skills were innovated generation after generation. Naturally, the present would not be inferior to the past. Currently, among the Beyond Grade As, the strength of the current generation was still stronger, especially with Black Star, who had broken the historical record.

"You guys are so noisy."

Han Xiao looked at them helplessly. Just watch the battle. He did not know why these people were so dramatic.

He retracted his gaze and turned to look at the many revivors who were returning to the battleship in groups. Suddenly, his eyes flickered, and he had an idea.

After hesitating for two seconds, Han Xiao raised his hand and opened the wide area communication channel.

"Seeing that you guys are having fun, my hands are a little itchy too. Who's interested in playing with me? I promise to be gentle. "
